explicit_limits: Separate reviews must be carried out by actual independent human reviewers; generated templates and agreement counts cannot establish independence.
No reviewer decisions are supplied or inferred by the software.
No natural defect or final gold reference is certified automatically.
RNF-only forward cases and exploratory converse cases are distinct denominators.
Original B6 catalogue/protocol and B6.2 experimental outputs remain immutable.
Official source describes five RNF cases; observed 18 RNF-only forward disagreements require version and label-semantics review.
CIC reference needs exact generator/source-version matching, not agreement-based source adjudication.
